title: Rosalind and the Room
author: Paloma Blackwood
blurb: Ivo Crane, an urban explorer mapping tunnels that aren't on any survey, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. But when all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must learn the song's last verse without singing along before the frost writes its final pattern.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
